purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel geometry for Kochi, Japan; failed access and source-search outcomes are not treated as evidence that no cadastre exists.
name: Kochi

queries.query: Kochi City Japan official cadastral parcel map GIS land parcel open data
queries.result: Found official Kochi City cadastral-survey page, official Kochi City budget describing public GIS construction and parcel-reference-map preparation, and national MLIT cadastral-information guidance; no city-bounded polygon API was established.

queries.query: 高知市 地籍図 GIS 土地 筆界 地図 公式
queries.result: Found official Kochi City pages for cadastral-survey results/procedures and parcel-reference maps; the city says parcel-reference maps are based on registry maps and local tax conditions, while cadastral-result drawings are handled through the city office. No downloadable public polygon response was verified.

officialSources.observation: Kochi City Cadastral Survey Division explains that cadastral surveys measure each parcel and produce cadastral maps and registers; certified results are sent to the registry office and copies are kept at city hall. This evidences a local cadastral procedure, not a public vector endpoint.
Kochi City provides a procedure page for issuing cadastral-survey result drawings and explains that treatment depends on the type of result. No machine-readable parcel service was exposed.

Kochi City says its parcel-reference map (地番参考図) is prepared from registry-office public maps and local conditions/tax information. It is a reference product and not a verified open cadastral geometry service.

FY2026 Kochi City budget describes construction/operation of a public GIS and preparation of parcel-reference maps, but does not provide a live endpoint or current parcel-layer URL in the inspected document.

requests.outcome: A public ArcGIS service named 地番図 was reachable. Metadata identifies a static, anonymously queryable service in EPSG:3857, but its full extent is approximately 140.00–140.18°E, not Kochi at 133.54°E; publisher/city ownership was not established.
Layer metadata reports geometryType esriGeometryPoint, native object ID FID, and only native fields FID, 大字名称, 表示文字列. It is not a full parcel-polygon layer.

Returned an empty FeatureCollection for a bounded Kochi-area envelope. Because the service extent is elsewhere and the layer is points, this is not evidence of citywide absence and no sample was retained.

registryBasis: Kochi City first-party pages evidence a local cadastral-survey and cadastral-result procedure, but no public city-bounded parcel geometry endpoint was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kochi City cadastral-survey and parcel-reference-map procedures described by first-party city sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-bounded public parcel polygon response verified. The inspected ArcGIS candidate is a point layer whose extent is outside Kochi.

remainingUncertainty: Kochi City is actively documenting cadastral surveys and parcel-reference maps, and its FY2026 budget describes a public GIS project, but the current public GIS endpoint, parcel-layer schema, geometry coverage, CRS, and stable safe parcel identity were not established in this bounded anonymous inspection. No exact-point hit or map extent miss is treated as citywide absence.
